title: :emoji: Looking For Self-Awareness... Still Loading
content:
This MetaFilter thread digs into a Wall Street Journal article about some parents being baffled about why their adult kids want distance, without much reflection as to why that might be. The comments quickly (and thoughtfully) unpack various circumstances, especially this one by  Uncle Glendinning and another by orange swan, both flagged as fantastic.

Everything from the total absence of self-reflection to the creative rewriting of past behavior and more is gently (and not so gently) covered. Definitely worth a click for the discussion alone!
author: Brandon Blatcher
